Package org.apache.poi.xssf.eventusermodel

Class XSSFReader

java.lang.Object
org.apache.poi.xssf.eventusermodel.XSSFReader
Direct Known Subclasses:
XSSFBReader
public class XSSFReader extends Object
This class makes it easy to get at individual parts of an OOXML .xlsx file, suitable for low memory sax parsing or similar. It makes up the core part of the EventUserModel support for XSSF.

    • getSheetCommentsPart

      public static PackagePart getSheetCommentsPart(PackagePart sheetPart, boolean allowStrictOoxmlFiles) throws InvalidFormatException
      Returns the comments part associated with a sheet.
      Parameters:
      sheetPart - the package part holding the sheet data
      allowStrictOoxmlFiles - whether to also look for the Strict OOXML comments relationship. Note that the returned part is then in Strict OOXML format and CommentsTable cannot parse it directly.
      Returns:
      the comments part, or null if the sheet has no comments or the part is missing
      Throws:
      InvalidFormatException - if the relationship target is not a valid part name
      Since:
      6.0.0

    • getSheetDrawingParts

      public static List<PackagePart> getSheetDrawingParts(PackagePart sheetPart, boolean allowStrictOoxmlFiles) throws InvalidFormatException
      Returns the drawing parts associated with a sheet. Missing parts are skipped.
      Parameters:
      sheetPart - the package part holding the sheet data
      allowStrictOoxmlFiles - whether to also look for the Strict OOXML drawing relationship. Note that the returned parts are then in Strict OOXML format and XSSFDrawing cannot parse them directly.
      Returns:
      the drawing parts, never null
      Throws:
      InvalidFormatException - if a relationship target is not a valid part name
      Since:
      6.0.0

    • getSheetsData

      public Iterator<InputStream> getSheetsData() throws IOException, InvalidFormatException
      Returns an Iterator which will let you get at all the different Sheets in turn. Each sheet's InputStream is only opened when fetched from the Iterator. It's up to you to close the InputStreams when done with each one.
      Throws:
      InvalidFormatException - if the sheet data format is invalid
      IOException - if there is an I/O issue reading the data
      See Also:
      • getSheetIterator()
